_about: Public-domain Mark Guy Pearse (1842-1930), Cornish Wesleyan Methodist preacher of the West London Mission, for the Word Hoard: Praise: Meditations in the 103rd Psalm (1862 cat.), Mister Horn and his Friends (1872), Daniel Quorm and his Religious Notions (1875), Sermons for Children (1876), John Tregenoweth (1877), Homely Talks (1880), Thoughts on Holiness (1884), Some Aspects of the Blessed Life (1887), Short Talks for the Times (1889), Parables and Pictures (1897), The Gentleness of Jesus (1898) and The God of our Pleasures (1898), from Internet Archive scans. Published before 1930, so public domain in the US. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 58 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
